headline: 14 arrested after fresh clash erupts over New Gini Properties land in Dhaka
summary: A brawl involving 100-150 people armed with local weapons broke out at the housing project in South Manikdi, leading to multiple injuries.
details: Police have arrested 14 people following a fresh brawl at the New Gini Properties housing project in Dhaka’s South Manikdi on Saturday afternoon.
According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), between 100 and 150 people armed with local weapons entered the project area and engaged in a fight.
Three of those arrested were seriously injured and were transferred from Kurmitola Multicare Specialized Hospital to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the 14 suspects.
This incident follows a previous attack on the project on September 26, where the site was vandalized and looted.
During the previous attack, the 'Brownfish' studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir was also targeted and damaged.
A case was filed by Saiful Islam Bhuiyan, director of New Gini Properties, naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury.
Eleven people have been arrested in connection with the September 26 attack, with eight of them currently out on bail.

headline_marked: Attack in Mirpur: [[Group attempts to torch passenger bus]] near Metro Station
headline: Attack in Mirpur: Group attempts to torch passenger bus near Metro Station
summary: Assailants on a motorcycle poured petrol on a Bihanga Paribahan bus, scorching several seats before staff extinguished the flames.
details: A group of people on a motorcycle allegedly attempted to set fire to a Bihanga Paribahan passenger bus in Dhaka's Mirpur-12 on Saturday night.
The incident occurred around 10pm near the Pallabi Metro Station, where the perpetrators poured petrol on the rear of the bus and tried to ignite it.
Bus staff managed to put out the flames quickly, though several seats inside the vehicle were scorched during the attack.
Pallabi Police Station chief Md Jalal Uddin confirmed the incident, stating that the bus has since been removed from the scene.
The attackers fled the scene immediately after the attempt, and police are investigating the matter.
